notes.title: 🎉 Updated TorchR Runners: Demastered Joins the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268555/053b5e4d2c3b79825175cb287b65acc2badc07ff.png[/img][h1]📅 Glorious Day: 30/01/2025![/h1]


Runners, brace yourselves! [b]TorchR Runners: Demastered[/b] is proudly part of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/CrunchingKoalas/sale/laughsandsmiles2025]Laughs & Smiles Game Festival[/url][/b], a digital showcase celebrating games that will make you laugh and/or smile! 😆✨ Get ready for some chaotic fun and spooky thrills!

Also, with the new game patch releasing today, [b]Master TorcherR[/b] has bestowed upon us another set of commands to enhance your (and our) suffering—err, gaming experience. Prepare your eyes for a feast and your spirits for more chaos in [b]TorchR Runners: Demastered[/b]!

[h2]🔍 What to Expect from Us:[/h2]
✔️ Co-op Chaos – Every death hurts the whole team! 💀🤝
✔️ The TorcherR’s Taunts – Your biggest fan... or worst enemy. 😈🎤
✔️ Simple Controls, Intense Gameplay – Easy to learn, tough to master. 🎮🔥
✔️ Somewhat Time-Based Pressure – Your torch won’t last forever, so hurry up! ⏳🕯️
✔️ Retro-Inspired Visuals & Eerie Atmosphere – Looks nostalgic, plays like a nightmare. 👾🌙
✔️ Enhanced Features – Thanks to our latest patch, enjoy smoother performance and better visuals. 🚀✨

[h2]Latest Game Patch Released![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268555/6719c5704f99f32ddbf88034cb41d7dcdc32e821.png[/img]
[b]🛠️ What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Gamepad Support[/b]: Now compatible with Xbox and Sony PlayStation controllers.
[*] [b]Local Split Screen Mode[/b]: Up to 4 players can join on a single PC.
[*] [b]DEhanced DEmastered Graphics[/b]: Embracing that nostalgic 90s aesthetic.
[*] [b]Overall Performance Updates[/b]: Smoother and more stable gameplay.
[*] [b]Adjusted Game Over Sound[/b]: Reduced volume for a less jarring experience (We did this against TorcherR’s will for your wellbeing).
[/list]

[b]💀 Try the Demo and See If You Can Handle the darkness! 💀[/b]

[h3]🔧 Further Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]DEhanced Graphics[/b]: Tweaked visuals, crunched textures, and more colors.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Squashed pesky bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Feature Overhauls[/b]: Revamped mechanics for sanity, jumpscares, torch management, and darkness to heighten immersion.
[*] [b]Selectable Characters[/b]: Choose from a variety of characters, so you know whom to blame.
[/list]

[h3]🔮 Farther in the Future:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Additional Levels[/b]: Introducing new stages to enhance the learning curve and keep the challenges fresh.
[*] [b]Customizable Difficulty[/b]: Tailor your experience by selecting difficulty settings that adjust level complexity.
[*] [b]Innovative Mechanics & Challenges[/b]: Stay tuned for new gameplay mechanics and obstacles that will test your skills.
[/list]

[h2]❤ Wishlist us on Steam![/h2] 
– Every wishlist fuels the flames and helps us reach more players🔥❤

[h2]🎮 Join the Fun:[/h2]
Check out the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival on Steam, play some awesome games, and let’s survive the madness together! 🤪🎉

🔗 [b]Connect with Us:[/b]
Have questions, feedback, or just want to chat? Join our Discord and become part of the chaos - https://discord.gg/AN3DCfuGsf Master is waiting four you! 💬🎮

[i][h1]Long live Master TorcherR.[/h1]
- The Minions[/i]
[strike](Still alive, still working…) 🛠️😴[/strike]

notes.title: Minions Streaming @ Four Is A Party Steam Festival
notes.content:
Runners! 🎺🎺

Gather 'round and behold your soon-to-be-favorite Minions, commanded by the almighty TorcherR (our generous and benevolent Master) to broadcast TorchR Runners: Demastered. We've been ordered to play the game for your entertainment—and by "play," we mean flail, fail, and generally make fools of ourselves.

Our Master calls this “training,” but let’s be honest: it feels a lot like public humiliation. Yes, we can see the chat, and we’ll answer your questions as best we can. Just don’t expect us to speak—it’s a workday, and TorcherR doesn’t allow screaming in the office (which, for the record, is a basement). We’re professionals. Kind of.

And hey, if you don’t have friends (or enemies) to play with and want to experience the chaos firsthand—rather than just laughing at our suffering—you can join our 💬  [url=https://discord.gg/WWpFqHBN]Discord [/url]and hop into a game with us. Misery loves company, after all. 😈😈

Otherwise, grab your snacks, fire up the chat, and enjoy the spectacle. We’re here for your amusement, whether we like it or not.

(LinkedIn copy paste)
🕒 Event Details:
📅 Broadcast Schedule: Every day during the festival
⏰ Time: 2 PM – 4 PM CET
📍 Where to Watch: Our Store Page
🔗 Discord Invite: [url=🔗 Discord Invite: https://discord.gg/WWpFqHBN]https://discord.gg/WWpFqHBN[/url]

--
Long live Master TorcherR. 
(Please send help)

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo Update 0.1 – Master TorcherR Commands It!
notes.content:
[h1]📅 Glorious Day: 26/11/2024![/h1]
Minions, rejoice! Master TorcherR has graciously allowed us to fix things (after much yelling). Behold the results of our scurrying!

[h1]⚡ Major Commands From Our Master[/h1]
[list]
[*][h3][i] [b]"ADD MENU! Runners love options!"[/b][/i][/h3]
[*] A shiny new menu has been added for graphics, sound, and even starting a new game.
[*] (Pro tip: Press ESC mid-game—no more excuses to slack off!)

[*][h3][i][b] "LOADING SCREENS NEED QUOTES!"[/b][/i][/h3]
[*] Inspirational (or terrifying) words of wisdom from our Master now grace the loading screens.
[*] Read them. Fear them. Love them.

[*][h3][i][b] "ENDGAME SCREEN FOR LOSERS!"[/b][/i][/h3]
[*] Whether you fail or succeed, a fancy new endgame screen awaits.

[*] [h3][i][b]“ADD EVIL MIST! Make everything scarier!”[/b][/i][/h3]
[*] A sinister fog now blankets the world, creeping into every corner.
[*] You can’t hide. You won’t escape. But it does look cool, right?

[*] [h3][b][i]“MORE HORROR! MORE FEAR!”[/i][/b][/h3]
[*] The game is darker, scarier, and 100% more likely to make you regret playing it.
[*] Don’t blame us—we just do what we’re told.
[/list]

[h1]🛠️ Specific Orders We Followed (Mostly)[/h1]
[h2]1️⃣ Sound Fixes & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added countless creepy sounds for that extra "atmosphere."
[*] Fixed breathing sounds!
[*] [i]Low sanity now means your Runner breathes like us after running from the Master.[/i]
[*] Buy sanity, and the creepy breathing stops.
[*] [i](Master says: “Good job. You’re alive. For now.”)[/i]
[*] Music now shifts depending on where you are.
[*] [i]We toiled for days perfecting the vibe. Don’t waste it.[/i]
[/list]
[h2]2️⃣ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the respawn curse: No more runners staying dead if they die together.
[*] Fixed pressure plates: They no longer scream endlessly when stepped on.
[*] Fixed greedy coin stashing: No more hoarding 500 coins, you sneaky minions.
[/list]
[h2]3️⃣ Multiplayer Magic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stabilized multiplayer.
[*] [i]No more sneaky runners joining sessions already in progress.[/i]
[*] Fixed lobbies: Lounge without randomly losing sanity or lives.
[*] (We suspect sabotage, but Master forgives none.)
[/list]
[h2]4️⃣ Graphics & Visual Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added glorious visual effects to amplify the terror.
[*] Fixed textures and map issues where runners could get stuck or fall into the void.
[*] Clients now see the same effects as the host.
[*] (The Master insists on consistency!)
[/list]

[h1]💬 Praise, Criticism, or Coin Offerings?[/h1]
Direct all correspondence to: https://discord.gg/uDrJ5mpM
Master TorcherR demands your input… but only the useful kind.

[b]Signed, The Minions[/b]
[i](Still alive, still working… barely.)[/i]
